<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **170** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json afc761c35fa475d1a1a48cda5982be994a7f079f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9fa594ce28ed246f0461d856a497f1cd9ee922ff` — the merge of head `8476878165579f66320292abdddcdbaa156d6149` into base `afc761c35fa475d1a1a48cda5982be994a7f079f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9fa594ce28ed246f0461d856a497f1cd9ee922ff && git checkout 9fa594ce28ed246f0461d856a497f1cd9ee922ff
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin afc761c35fa475d1a1a48cda5982be994a7f079f 8476878165579f66320292abdddcdbaa156d6149 && git checkout -B drift-repro afc761c35fa475d1a1a48cda5982be994a7f079f && git merge --no-ff 8476878165579f66320292abdddcdbaa156d6149

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json afc761c35fa475d1a1a48cda5982be994a7f079f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs afc761c35fa475d1a1a48cda5982be994a7f079f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8476878165579f66320292abdddcdbaa156d6149`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts (full diff vs merge-base dfafae81, plus the head's helper bodies: pickData :546, localeChain :578, packagedPart :2114, packagedObjectField :2143, valueOverridesPackagedBase :4522, translateObjectValidations :4668, every lookup* the eight translators call), packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts (the new describe, 75 tests), .changeset/30193-override-label-pair-precedence.md; at origin/main: packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts :2887 :2954 :3040-3115 :3165-3175, packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts :385 :421, packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts :189, packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts :3785, ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts :482 :489, ui/packages/app-shell (AppHeader.tsx :750, appReportIndex.ts :324, useRecentItemLabel.ts :122, servedNavText.ts), docs/adr/0146 D2/D3, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs :880-1004, skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md :128, skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md, AGENTS.md; card #30193 and its 4 comments, card #30062 body and ruling 6631250894, PR #30236 body and 2 comments, check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Rule fidelity: holds. One helper pair, `labelCatalogs` (i18n-resolver.ts :83) and `catalogFor` (:107), and every string of the eight translators reads `catalogFor(catalogs, valueOverridesPackagedBase(the matching base node, attr, value))`: view :333-342 and bulk-action defs :172, form sections :227, entries :258, form title :279, thank-you panel :300 (through translateFormSubmitBehavior :1469); dashboard :530-535, global filter :495 and options :508, widgets :555-566; report :750-756, blocks :723-730; object scalars :1122 (scalarOverridesPackagedBase, the same predicate :4501), field label :1148-1155, help :1184-1193, inlineTitle :1199, relatedListTitle :1211, options :1223-1228, listViews :1096-1103; page label/description :927-938, component copy key by key :963-972, tab items :836, thank-you :998-1000, header title/subtitle :1009-1014, interface tabs :1066; dataset :641-648 and members :598; app :450-455 and nav nodes :463-464; book :684-689 and groups :697. The only raw-bundle reads left inside the eight are the two accepted deviations: translateObjectValidations (diff :1239) and the inline-action translateAction (:1728-1753). View columns and report columns were never translated at the base, so nothing was skipped. Every nested node is matched by its stable key (name, id, field, value, key), never by index: dataset members by `name` :597, book groups by `key` :696, app nav by `id` with a depth-first first-wins map :398-412, page components by `id` through the same walk and collision arbitration the translator reads the served page with :869-884, tab items by `value` :834, interface tabs by `name` :1065.
2. Changed detection: `valueOverridesPackagedBase` (:4522) is false with no base, false for a non-string or empty value, else `base[key] !== value`; applied per string against the matching base node. An item the override added gets `{}` from packagedPart/packagedObjectField/packagedNavNodes/packagedPageParts (base known, no counterpart), so every non-empty string on it counts as changed: pair only, else its own text. An item the base has and the override dropped is absent from the served document and is never touched. An inline locale map is never changed, so it keeps the catalog reading it has today.
3. Byte identity: with no `pairBundle`, `labelCatalogs` returns `{ unchanged: bundle, changed: undefined }` (:88, the same reference), and every lookup answers `undefined` on an undefined catalog (pickData :549 and the added `if (!bundle)` guards :190 :206 :315 :804), so a changed string falls back to its own value exactly as the former `? value : lookup` arms did; I traced view, dashboard, report, object (label, the help slot restructure, options) and the page header (`resolvePageHeaderTitle` :774-791 with the dropped early return) and found no divergence. The same holds for `packagedBase` without a pair on the four former types. The no-bundle short-circuit (:94, a pair answering no chain locale) returns the same references and is pinned (test.diff :286-291). No caller moves today: the server passes `packagedBase` only for object, dashboard, view and report (`PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` meta-item-read-gate.ts :2954, read through `packagedObjectBaseOf` :2976 on item :3109, list :3050 and view-container :3173 reads; form-routes.ts :385 :421) and no caller anywhere in packages/, ui/ or cli passes `pairBundle`; page, dataset, app and book receive `packagedBase: undefined`.
4. Locale chain: `unchanged` is keyed by every chain code with `overlay(pickData(bundle, code), pickData(pair, code)) ?? {}` (:99-103), so a lookup's chain walk reads pair zh-CN, catalog zh-CN, pair en, catalog en; `changed` is the pair itself, walked by the same `localeChain` and BCP-47 ladder (pickData :546), so a pair shipping only `en` answers a zh-CN viewer's changed string with its `en` text when `en` is in the declared chain, and with the override's own text otherwise (default-locale readings skip the chain, #15711, unchanged). The `{}` for a code neither bundle answers stops pickData's variant expansion from re-resolving against another chain code, which keeps the unchanged catalog exactly the merged bundle's reading.
5. Pins: per type (test.diff :198-303) the pair wins top-level and nested :228, the override's own label beats the base's translation with no pair and with an empty pair in zh-CN and en :233, an unchanged label keeps the base's translation beside a changed one :243, an untouched label takes the pair's :252, the per-locale interleave :257, no packagedBase :265, byte-identity with an empty and an off-chain pair with and without a base plus reference identity :272, no input mutated :295; nested slots per type cover bulk action, widget, block, field and option, component copy and tab item, measure and dimension, nested nav node, group; page header restatement :305-333. The three ablations named (pair never read, interleave dropped, changed strings reading the merged catalog) each have rows that can only pass through the new code; the counts (41, 8, 16) are consistent with the rows per type.
6. Deviations: both real and stated in the body and the changeset. The validations one leaves a visible inconsistency the body does not name (should-fix 2). Studio: the Console header finding is accurate at origin/main (useObjectLabel.ts :482 pageLabel and :489 reportLabel resolve the catalog key first; callers AppHeader.tsx :750, appReportIndex.ts :324, useRecentItemLabel.ts :122), so card acceptance 3 is not met by this PR (should-fix 3).
7. Body vs code: the precedence tables, the pair-provenance design (translationBundleOf :2887, getTranslations :189, readAuthoredTranslationLayer, rule-validator :3785) and the Studio file:lines all check out; the Skills-docs owed line names the right paragraph (objectstack-platform SKILL.md :128) and the i18n skill has no line on overridden items; the 维护者速读 matches the code and the report. Check-runs on the head at review time: 26 success, 9 skipped, 26 in_progress, 0 failed.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec` patch is right under Ruling A (check-changeset-no-major.mjs :901-931, AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3): the level follows the `Metadata-protocol:` line alone, and `none` is correct (no authorable key, value, default or meaning moves). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is the right meaning: a new optional member on the exported `TranslateDocumentOptions` and four third-parameter types widened from `ResolveOptions` to its subtype, additive for every caller; api-surface/system.json lists exports only, so no regeneration is owed. ADR-0087 is correctly not needed: nothing is removed, renamed or re-shaped. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- packages/spec only; no server, protocol or ui file moves. Governed surface: a `.custom` override rule under ADR-0146 D2, which the code cites (:36 :54) with ruling record 6631250894.
- The server half (passing `packagedBase` for page, dataset, app and book, and `pairBundle` for every declared override) is #30062's and is not here; until it lands no user-visible behaviour changes, which the PR says.
- `Fixes #30193` closes a card whose acceptance 3 (Studio reads the runtime's answer) this PR carries to an unfiled ui card.

### ④ Design judgment

The design is sound: one comparison, two catalogs built once per document, the interleave at the right grain, and the page header restatement reasoned through (a title the override left as the base wrote it translates as the base's label, test.diff :320). Three should-fix items, no must-fix:

- should-fix 1 (body, server contract): "omit both for an item that is not an override" contradicts today's server, which passes `packagedBase` for every served object, dashboard, view and report (#8284 and #20730, meta-item-read-gate.ts :3050 :3109) and needs it for extension-folded object field labels (ADR-0029 D9.2a, #27559, packagedObjectField :2143). A server dev building from that line would regress the four types. Say: keep `packagedBase` as today for the four types and add the same accessor for page, dataset, app and book; omit only `pairBundle` for a non-override. Also say whether the pair's code-shipped translation items count beside its authored rows (they should: both layers are the pair's own).
- should-fix 2 (body and changeset): name the visible effect of the validations deviation. On an overridden object a `validations[].message` the override reworded never takes the pair's translation while its labels do, and an unchanged message reads the merged catalog where the pair's row can lose to the base's by merge order (file-i18n-adapter.ts :189 deepMerge, readAuthoredTranslationLayer by item name). State that lifting it needs a pair input on the objectql evaluator (rule-validator.ts :3785) and the resolver together, and name the follow-up card.
- should-fix 3 (process): file the Console header ui card (useObjectLabel.ts :482 :489 served-label-first) and link it on #30193 before the card closes, or change `Fixes` to `Part-of`, since acceptance 3 stays open after this merge.
- optional: an ADR anchor under scripts/adr-anchors/ for `labelCatalogs` (Prime Directive 13), the one locus of the ruled order; none exists for this file.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `.custom` 配对包覆盖基础包条目时，八类元数据（视图、仪表盘、报表、对象、页面、数据集、应用、手册）的每个标签都按同一顺序取文字：配对包自带的译文 → 覆盖项自己写的文字 → 基础包的译文。覆盖项没改的标签照旧用基础包译文。
  - 新增一个可选项 `pairBundle`，存放配对包自己的译文。
  - 页面、数据集、应用、手册四类开始读 `packagedBase`。
- **为什么改：** #30193。那四类会把覆盖项改过的标签盖回基础包译文；另外四类则读不到配对包自带的译文，因为服务端给的是一份合并词典，分不清译文出自哪个包。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加了一个可选项，不传时输出逐字节不变。服务端还没传 `pairBundle`，页面等四类也还没拿到 `packagedBase`，所以合并后用户可见行为不变，要等 #30062 的服务端那一半。回滚就是还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `labelCatalogs` / `catalogFor`；同文件末尾的测试块 "label precedence on an overridden item"。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd packages/spec && pnpm exec vitest run --project local src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts -t "label precedence on an overridden item"`，75 个测试全过。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：fable 契约复审一轮 PASS，没有必须修的。三条建议都已处理：
- 服务端契约原写「非覆盖项两个都不传」，会让现有四类回退。席位已在 PR 正文改正。
- 校验消息不走配对规则的影响已写进正文，并另开卡 #30245。
- 控制台页头会用基础包译文盖掉服务端答案，已开 ui 卡 #30244。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#3 · head `8476878165579f66320292abdddcdbaa156d6149`

- **Shape:** 3 files on `origin/main` `dfafae81` (+893 −169):
  - `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`: the new optional `TranslateDocumentOptions.pairBundle`; one shared rule `labelCatalogs` / `catalogFor` read by every string of the eight translators; `translatePage`, `translateDataset`, `translateApp` and `translateBook` read `packagedBase`;
  - `i18n-resolver.test.ts`: 75 table-driven pins over all eight types;
  - a patch changeset.
- **Premise measured:** the dev's pair-provenance measure at `dfafae81` (the server merges every package's code bundle and every authored translation row into one catalog per locale, so the resolver could not tell the pair's translation from the base's). The seat approved the design before the build.
- **Gates:** the dev ran all 78 dispatch-gates at `84768781`, all exit 0, `--ran` reconciles 78/78 with 0 NOT-MEASURED. 1099/1099 resolver-importing spec tests green. The byte-identity run forced an empty pair onto every existing fixture call; its one red (reference identity with no bundle) is closed by the short-circuit, which is pinned. Three ablations each go red (41, 8, 16 of 75). Check-runs at review time: 26 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed, the rest in progress; the queue is the final verdict.
- **Contract review:** full review 6648581045 on this head: PASS, no must-fix. It traced rule fidelity across all eight translators and every nested node by stable key, per-string change detection, byte identity with no pair, and the per-locale interleave.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@objectstack/spec` patch (`check-changeset-no-major` exit 0). ADR-0087 not needed: nothing removed, renamed or re-shaped.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  - Object `validations[].message` and inline `translateAction` stay on the plain merged bundle (seat ruling on the design). The visible effect is now named in the body, and the follow-up is #30245.
  - Should-fix 2 also asked for that sentence in the changeset. It is in the PR body only: the changeset describes what the release changes, and this deviation changes nothing a user sees until #30062 lands.
  - The optional ADR anchor for `labelCatalogs` is not added.
- **Carried:**
  - Server half: #30062 (`domain:server`). Its contract is in the body, corrected in r1 so `packagedBase` stays on the four types for every served item and only `pairBundle` is override-only.
  - Console header re-translating served labels: #30244 (`domain:ui`, p2, blocked by #30062). Card acceptance 3 (Studio = runtime) is met by the spec half for Studio's rails; the Console header rides #30244.
  - Skills lines owed while the skills lane is paused: `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:128` and `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, listed in the body.
- **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 30236`: 0 of 3 paths, 1062 lines). The hand-off is `pr_ready` plus `automerge_enable`, through the merge queue.
